zh: 把某个元素改成1最划算：任何包含它的连续段GCD都变成1，而且不会产生新的坏段。问题于是变成最少修改几个位置，才能把所有过长的坏段都打断。
答案具有单调性，可以二分最大允许长度L：只要每个长度为L+1且原GCD大于1的窗口里至少有一个被修改的位置即可。最少修改数用贪心求：从左到右遇到第一个还没被命中的坏窗口，就修改它的最右端。窗口GCD用稀疏表O(1)查询。
预处理GCD稀疏表；判定L时令len=L+1，若len>n直接可行；否则从i=0开始扫描，用两段重叠区间的GCD判断窗口[i,i+len)是否为坏窗口：若是，修改数加1（超过maxChange则不可行），并让i跳过len个位置，因为改掉的右端覆盖了起点在i到i+len−1的所有窗口；否则i加1。在0到n之间二分出最小的可行L。
en: Changing an element to 1 is the best possible change: every segment containing it gets GCD 1, and no new bad segment appears. So the question becomes how few positions must be changed to break every bad segment that is too long.

The answer is monotone, so binary search the largest allowed length L: every window of length L+1 whose original GCD exceeds 1 must contain a changed position. The fewest changes come from a greedy: moving left to right, at the first bad window not yet hit, change its rightmost element. A GCD sparse table answers each window in O(1).

Build the GCD sparse table. To test L, let len = L+1; if len > n it is feasible. Otherwise scan from i = 0 and use the GCD of two overlapping power-of-two blocks to decide whether window [i, i+len) is bad: if so, count one change (more than maxChange means infeasible) and jump i forward by len, since the changed right end covers every window starting in i..i+len-1; otherwise move i by one. Binary search the smallest feasible L in 0..n.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Changing a value to 1 is the most beneficial change. Binary search the allowed length L: every window of length L+1 whose original GCD is > 1 must be hit by a changed position; greedily, from left to right, change the right end of the first bad window not yet hit. A GCD sparse table answers each window query in O(1).

## Proof of correctness

Changing an element to 1 eliminates every bad segment containing that position and creates no new bad segment, so it is no worse than any other value. A bad segment longer than L exists if and only if there is a bad window of length L+1. For intervals ordered by right end, choosing the rightmost point of the first interval not yet hit is the standard optimal covering greedy; length L is feasible when the number of changes needed is <= the budget, and feasibility is monotone.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n log n).
